# Vendored dependencies

These files are served locally; visitors do not depend on a CDN.

| Library | Version | Source | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Three.js | 0.170.0 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/three/v/0.170.0 | MIT, see THREE-LICENSE.txt |
| GSAP + ScrollTrigger | 3.15.0 | User-supplied gsap-public distribution | Standard license: https://gsap.com/standard-license/ (also referenced in both distribution headers) |
| Lenis | 1.3.11 | https://www.npmjs.com/package/lenis/v/1.3.11 | MIT, see LENIS-LICENSE.txt |

Lenis and Three.js distributions were downloaded from jsDelivr's npm mirror. GSAP and ScrollTrigger were updated from the supplied local gsap-public package. Keep license headers when updating. Three.js is retained from the previous version and is not loaded by Landscape Assembly.

The interactive terrain, shader changes, portfolio animations and translations are original implementation. No reference-site source code, photography, video or project artwork was copied.
